claims.feature: other: invented world as historical ethic
claims.claim: Cabon writes that one reason Kay sets fact-based plots in invented worlds is his refusal to betray historical figures by presuming their reactions.
claims.source: Mikael Cabon, « Les Chevaux célestes pour "les cancres" », Éditions L'Atalante, 11 July 2014
claims.quote: son refus de trahir les personnages historiques en présumant de leurs réactions

claims.claim: The translator's own page for Voile vers Sarance carries the line announcing Kay's Byzantine epic in a new translation.
claims.source: Mikael Cabon, translator's own page for Voile vers Sarance (L'Atalante)
claims.page: back-cover text reproduced on the page

claims.claim: Elbakin forum readers record that A Brightness Long Ago had already been translated by Élisabeth Vonarburg and published in 2020 before the L'Atalante version appeared.
claims.source: Elbakin.net forum thread on Comme un diamant dans ma mémoire (reader posts)
claims.quote: Il avait déjà été traduit par Élisabeth Vonarburg et paru en 2020

claims.claim: Kay's site records that The Last Light of the Sun audiobook was read by Holter Graham.
claims.quote: Last Light of the Sun is wrapped, read by Holter Graham

claims.claim: Kay's site records that A Song for Arbonne was read by Euan Morton, who also sang the songs.
claims.quote: read by Euan Morton (who sang the songs, as well)

claims.claim: Gillossen calls Kay's multiplication of period terms in The Last Light of the Sun sometimes incidental to what it adds to the story.
claims.source: Gillossen, critique of Les Derniers Feux du soleil, Elbakin.net, 19 April 2009

claims.feature: other: competing memories of one event
claims.claim: Siriane observes that in Children of Earth and Sky the same events can be examined from the points of view of different characters, which she calls a kaleidoscopic effect.
claims.source: Siriane, critique of Children of Earth and Sky, Elbakin.net, 20 January 2017
claims.quote: ce qui donne un intéressant effet kaléidoscopique

claims.claim: Elbakin.net records that after a first publication at Le Pré aux Clercs the novel was reissued by L'Atalante with a translation by Mikael Cabon.
claims.source: Elbakin.net, update of 20 August 2021 appended to the Les Derniers Feux du soleil page
claims.quote: avec cette fois une traduction de Mikael Cabon

claims.claim: Haggard criticises The Summer Tree for having characters stop the action dead to make a flowery speech.
claims.source: Cynthia Sally Haggard, review of the Simon Vance audiobook of The Summer Tree, 24 May 2020
claims.quote: stops the action dead in order to make a flowery speech

verdicts.trueWording: son refus de trahir les personnages historiques en présumant de leurs réactions
verdicts.note: Raw page fetched (curl, browser UA). Fourth paragraph of the article, signed Mikael Cabon, dated 11 juillet 2014: Kay integrates plots founded on authentic facts into fictional universes for ethical and artistic reasons, among them the cited refusal (which continues '...et de leurs sentiments'). Quotation is a contiguous substring; every limb (Cabon as author; fact-based plots; invented worlds; refusal to presume reactions) is on the page.

verdicts.trueWording: L'ÉPOPÉE BYZANTINE DE GUY GAVRIEL KAY DANS UNE NOUVELLE TRADUCTION
verdicts.note: Raw page fetched. mikaelcabon.fr is headed 'Mikael Cabon, traducteur'; the Voile vers Sarance page reproduces the quatrieme de couverture and closes it with the em-dash banner line containing the quoted words verbatim (in capitals). Byzantine limb supported both by the banner and by the back-cover text naming Justinian's Constantinople.

verdicts.trueWording: Il avait déjà été traduit par Élisabeth Vonarburg et paru en 2020
verdicts.note: Live page initially failed (HTTP/2 PROTOCOL_ERROR, then empty reply); recovered on the live URL by first taking a phpBB session cookie from index.php, then re-requesting over HTTP/1.1 with that cookie. Page 4 of 7 confirmed. Post by 'Al1', jeu. 24 août 2023: the novel is a Cabon translation of 'A Brightness Long Ago' (2019), and the quoted sentence continues 'sous le nom "Un éclat d'antan"'; he adds L'Atalante's site makes no mention of the earlier one. A second reader (Aerendhyl) re-quotes it and identifies it as the Alire edition.

verdicts.trueWording: c'est parfois là aussi quelque peu « accessoire »
verdicts.note: Raw page fetched. Third paragraph of the chronique, signed '— Gillossen, le 19/04/2009': Kay tries to offset a less exotic Celtic setting 'avec notamment une multiplication de termes "d'époque"' — the quotation verbatim — but this is sometimes only incidental 'quant à l'intérêt réel que tout cela apporte à l'histoire'. Both limbs (the multiplication of period terms; sometimes incidental to what it adds) are on the page.

verdicts.trueWording: ce qui donne un intéressant effet kaléidoscopique

Penultimate paragraph of the chronique, signed '— Siriane, le 20/01/2017': key events 'peuvent d'ailleurs être étudiés sous le point de vue de différents personnages,' followed by the quoted clause verbatim. Same-events, different-POV and kaleidoscopic limbs both supported; review is of Children of Earth and Sky (French edition, L'Atalante).

verdicts.trueWording: avec cette fois une traduction de Mikael Cabon

Block headed 'Mise à jour du 20 aout 2021' at the foot of the Les Derniers Feux du soleil page: after a first publication at Le Pré aux Clercs the novel appears in a new edition at L'Atalante, closing with the quoted words verbatim. All three limbs (prior Pré aux Clercs publication; L'Atalante reissue; Cabon translation) present.
